basic_details.job_title: DLSA Palamau Driver Recruitment 2026 – Apply Offline
basic_details.short_information: DLSA Palamau Recruitment 2026 is for one Driver (Chalak) for the Mahindra Bolero MUV vehicle of the District Legal Services Authority (Jila Vidhik Seva Pradhikar), Palamau. The job is purely temporary and on contract. The first contract is for 01 to 11 months (maximum). The pay is the daily wage fixed by the State Government, plus a meal allowance of ₹100 for each day. To apply, you must have passed Matric (10th) and hold a valid LMV/Transport driving licence. Send the filled form by Speed Post or Courier so that it reaches the office by 20 November 2026.

how_to_apply: Get the application form (Performa) from https://palamu.dcourts.gov.in.
Fill in every part of the form and paste your photograph in the box.
Sign the declaration and write the date and place.
Attach self-attested copies of your certificates. The list is below.
Put everything, including the stamped self-addressed envelope, inside one large envelope.
Write the name of the post, "Driver", on the outside of the large envelope.
Send it by Speed Post/Courier to: Secretary, District Legal Services Authority, Civil Court, Palamau, PIN - 822101.
Make sure it reaches by 20 November 2026. Applications received after this date will not be accepted under any circumstances.
Self-attested copy of your educational certificate
Self-attested copy of your driving licence
One self-addressed envelope with ₹55 of postage stamps on it
important_instructions: In the declaration on the form, you confirm that your details are true. If any detail is found false or misleading, your candidature may be cancelled and legal action may be taken. Copies of certificates must be self-attested. The notice tells candidates to see https://palamu.dcourts.gov.in for more information.

content_sections.heading: About DLSA Palamau
content_sections.text: The District Legal Services Authority, Palamau is based at Daltonganj, and its office is in the Civil Court, Palamau. The Driver will drive and look after its Mahindra Bolero MUV vehicle. The Secretary of the Authority sent this public notice to the Registrar, Civil Courts Palamau at Daltonganj, under Letter No. 2398/26 dated 22 October 2026, asking for it to be put on the Civil Court website. The letter refers to JHALSA Letter No. 1695, dated 30.03.2026.

content_sections.heading: Who Can Apply
content_sections.text: To apply for the Driver post, you must meet all of these conditions: You must be a citizen of India. You must have passed the Matric (10th) examination. This is mandatory. You must hold a valid driving licence (LMV/Transport). You must have enough driving experience. The notice does not set a number of years. You must be of good character and physically able to do the work. You must be at least 18 years old and no older than 35 years on the date of application. The application form also asks for: your driving licence number, its date of issue and validity, the issuing RTO and the vehicle class (LMV/HMV/Transport etc.) your driving experience in years details of any previous or current employer whether a criminal case is pending or registered against you in any court whether you are fully fit, physically and mentally, to drive a vehicle For the full eligibility rules for the post, see the official notification. content_sections.heading: Pay and Tenure
content_sections.text: The appointment is purely temporary and on contract. Pay is the daily wage that the State Government fixes from time to time. You also get a meal allowance of ₹100 for each day. The first contract is for 01 to 11 months (maximum). It may be extended if your work is satisfactory, at the discretion of the District Legal Services Authority, Palamau. The job gives no right to regularisation, permanent appointment or continuity of service under any circumstances. The District Legal Services Authority, Palamau may end the service at any time without giving a reason.

content_sections.heading: DLSA Palamau Driver Job Description
content_sections.text: Carry out the work given by the District Legal Services Authority, Palamau. Drive the vehicle (Mahindra Bolero MUV) safely. Maintain the vehicle.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for DLSA Palamau Driver
content_sections.text: Get the application form (Performa) from https://palamu.dcourts.gov.in. Fill in every part of the form and paste your photograph in the box. Sign the declaration and write the date and place. Attach self-attested copies of your certificates. The list is below. Put everything, including the stamped self-addressed envelope, inside one large envelope. Write the name of the post, "Driver", on the outside of the large envelope. Send it by Speed Post/Courier to: Secretary, District Legal Services Authority, Civil Court, Palamau, PIN - 822101. Make sure it reaches by 20 November 2026. Applications received after this date will not be accepted under any circumstances. Self-attested copy of your educational certificate 2 recent passport-size photographs Self-attested copy of your driving licence Experience certificate (if any) Any other documents (if any) One self-addressed envelope with ₹55 of postage stamps on it

faq.question: Q1. How many vacancies are there in DLSA Palamau Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There is 1 vacancy. The District Legal Services Authority, Palamau needs one Driver for its Mahindra Bolero MUV vehicle.

faq.question: Q2. What is the last date for the DLSA Palamau Driver application?
faq.answer: The application must reach the office by 20 November 2026. Applications received after this date will not be accepted under any circumstances.

faq.question: Q3. What qualification do I need for the DLSA Palamau Driver post?
faq.answer: You must have passed Matric (10th), hold a valid LMV/Transport driving licence and have enough driving experience. You must also be an Indian citizen, of good character and physically able to do the work.

faq.question: Q4. What is the age limit for the DLSA Palamau Driver post?
faq.answer: You must be at least 18 years old and no older than 35 years on the date of application.

faq.question: Q5. What is the salary of the DLSA Palamau Driver?
faq.answer: The Driver gets the daily wage fixed by the State Government from time to time, plus a meal allowance of ₹100 for each day.

faq.question: Q6. How do I apply for the DLSA Palamau Driver post?
faq.answer: Fill in the form (Performa) from https://palamu.dcourts.gov.in and attach self-attested copies of your documents. Send it by Speed Post/Courier to the Secretary, District Legal Services Authority, Civil Court, Palamau, PIN - 822101.

faq.question: Q7. What should I write on the envelope?
faq.answer: Write the name of the post, "Driver", on the outside of the large envelope that holds your application and documents.

faq.question: Q8. Is the DLSA Palamau Driver job permanent?
faq.answer: No. The job is purely temporary and on contract, for 01 to 11 months (maximum) at first. It may be extended if your work is satisfactory, but it gives no right to regularisation or permanent appointment.

faq.question: Q9. What must I send with the DLSA Palamau Driver application?
faq.answer: Send 2 recent passport-size photographs, self-attested copies of your educational certificate and driving licence, and your experience certificate if you have one. Also include a self-addressed envelope with ₹55 of postage stamps.
